text: The purpose of this report is to seek authorization from the Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto to submit a grant application to the Department of Canadian Heritage - the Canada Arts Presentation Fund (under the Professional Arts Festivals and Performing Arts Series Presenters) to assist with the presentation of dance programs in the 2019-2020 performance season.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Authorized and directed the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto to submit a grant application to the Canada Arts Presentation Fund together with all necessary supporting documentation, provided that it meets the eligibility criteria of the grant application.
